protocol.purpose: Compare frozen packaged v1 with the final validation-selected delay-aware v2 on v2 predeclared held-out cases, after training exits. This decision uses the holdout and is not a subsequent independent confirmation.
protocol.v2_sha256: Freeze and record only after trainer exit.
protocol.backend: CPU; one torch thread; existing learning.train.evaluate
protocol.failed_or_infeasible_cases: Keep all in denominator. Do not replace seeds or remove hard cases.
protocol.incomplete_evaluation: Do not report partial completion fraction. Preserve stopped status and rerun only as a disclosed new attempt.
protocol.reuse_v2_builtin_holdout: Only if complete, case bank and source hashes match, and selected steps agree with the frozen checkpoint. Builtin holdout also uses CPU.
protocol.flight_candidate_criterion: At least as many strict successes, no more collisions or boundary violations, plus either at least one extra strict success or equal successes with >=10% lower median successful route time and no worse minimum window clearance. Do not promote based only on lower imitation loss.
limits: Eight paired analytic cases, not a reliability estimate.
Flight boundary braking guard is absent in analytic evaluation.
Teacher geometry is privileged; actor receives depth and estimated state.
No Gazebo/PX4, OAK stereo, or physical aircraft transfer established by this benchmark.

profile.name: x500-transfer-v2
profile.envelope_model: SDF body and gear boxes, swept rotors; no sensor housing collider
profile.collision_result: Continuous conservative component sweeps; unresolved overlap counts as failure

v2_evaluation_source: Complete built-in CPU final holdout, reused without changing the case bank.
